title: Shade Net UV-Resistant – Sun Protection for Patio
descriptionHtml:
Cool shade on the patio

Blazing sun makes it hard to sit outside in the middle of the day. Plants and the pool also suffer from the strong sun.

UV-resistant and durable

This shade net is UV-resistant and stands up to wind and weather season after season. It lets air through while giving pleasant shade where you need it.

Features

  • UV-resistant and durable
  • Gives cool shade to patio and plants
  • Lets air through
  • Available in several sizes
  • Great for deck, pool and garden

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
